scope: Admit acyclic pattern paints in retained tile scenes. Share existing sealed child owners, validate the actual content graph once before rasterization, and remove the obsolete blanket exclusions and resource-use kind.

implementation.ownership: Existing document scenes retain each child once; pattern, alias and glyph paints borrow them. The iterative graph walk visits geometry and mask content with budgeted temporary lookup/stack storage, cancellation per edge and deterministic scratch release.
implementation.errors: Cycles remain UnsupportedFeature. More than32 vector-scene levels returns LimitExceeded. Collapsed template href aliases add no content depth. Missing paint and selected/unused resource contracts remain separate.

mechanisms.coverage: Forward/backward definition order, rectangle/path paints, sibling owner identity through aliases, self/two-node/alias cycles, tile-mask cycles, and32/33 actual depth with successful rasterization at32.

responsibilities.textReplay: Four existing direct/text-path and forward/backward cases now preserve definition-order parity and successful cleanup. Independent glyph references validate paint output; solid and pattern materials are not assumed equivalent.
contracts: One prepared-font case acquires the reachable font exactly once and ignores an unused declaration.
One memory-refusal case releases owners and retries with the same host allowance. Existing pattern cancellation, missing-resource and recursion cases remain selected.
responsibilities.rendering: Two canonical conversions: forward/shared rectangle/polygon tiles and supplied-font direct/text-path glyph paints. Each has three agreeing healthy/profile-cleaned fresh native captures per host; glyph platform differences are retained. No API-form matrix expansion.

positiveBeforeAfter.timing: Same two positive cases; functional elapsed time, not a benchmark.
